description: This file defines the LiveCommandAnswer interface, which specifies methods for retrieving command response and event objects related to a received LiveCommand in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswer
classes.description: Interface defining methods to get optional command response and event related to a LiveCommand.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the CommandResponse for the answer, or empty if none exists.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Event for the answer, or empty if none exists.
